goals.goal: The controller implements appropriate technical and organisational measures — such as pseudonymisation — designed to implement data-protection principles (data minimisation) in an effective manner and to integrate the necessary safeguards into the processing at the time of means-determination and at the time of processing, and ensures that by default only personal data necessary for each specific purpose are processed, calibrated to the state of the art, cost of implementation, nature/scope/context/purposes of processing, and risks of varying likelihood and severity for an 8-person SaaS platform on managed cloud.
goals.adjustment: Restated from the corpus controller-side by-design + by-default obligation (req 7.1.1) to the company's scale: the 4-factor qualitative proportionality is applied to a small SaaS controller/processor on managed cloud; by-default limits (amount, extent, storage period, accessibility) are operationalised through the platform's minimal-data-collection and minimal-access design; no mechanism prescribed beyond the OJ text.

goals.goal: The manufacturer ensures that the product with digital elements (SaaS platform + web/mobile interface) has been designed, developed and produced in accordance with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I Part I, with the cybersecurity risk assessment taken into account across the planning, design, development, production, delivery and maintenance phases, with a view to minimising cybersecurity risks, preventing incidents, and minimising their impact including in relation to the health and safety of users, at the scale of a default-class self-assessment manufacturer.
goals.adjustment: Restated from the corpus manufacturer-side product by-design + 6-phase risk-assessment-propagation obligation (req 7.1.3) to the company's scale: the 6-phase propagation applies to the SaaS + web/mobile product lifecycle; Annex I Part I essential requirements are applied at the default-class self-assessment conformity level; no AI/ML components are present, so AI-Act-specific attack categories do not apply.
